description:
Discover the chilling truth behind Ted Bundy's final moments and his execution at Florida State Prison.
What really happened in the final day of Ted Bundy — and what were his last thoughts before death?


00:40 – 7 AM

It’s the last day of Ted Bundy. Outside, reporters gather. A growing crowd cheers as others protest the Ted Bundy execution.
This is the moment the world has waited for — the end of Ted Bundy, and the long-awaited Ted Bundy execution.

02:00 – 8 AM

Inside Florida State Prison, he reads the Bible and meets with Reverend Fred Lawrence. Ted Bundy now feels powerless. The serial killer reflects on the lives he took and the darkness within. The world watches the final day of Ted Bundy, waiting for the end at Florida State Prison.

03:35 – 9 AM

Inside Florida State Prison. Ted Bundy reflects on childhood secrets, family darkness, and early signs of violence. A phone call with his mother brings talk of remorse, forgiveness, and what comes after death.
The world keeps watching the final 24 hours of Ted Bundy, waiting for the Ted Bundy execution.

04:42 – 10 AM

The Supreme Court denying the final appeal, there’s no delay. Inside Florida State Prison, preparations begin. Security tightens as Warden James Crosby follows protocol. Investigator Bob Keppel, who studied him for years, reflects on their last intense talk. The manipulative killer tries once more to control the story.
The clock is ticking — the final day of Ted Bundy moves forward.

05:55 – 11 AM

Outside Florida State Prison, civil attorney Diane Weiner speaks to the press, hoping for a last-minute delay in the Ted Bundy execution. Inside, Polly Nelson visits one last time — both know the end is near. Ted Bundy breaks down, showing emotion at last. Later, he speaks with Detective Bob Keppel and FBI Agent Bill Hagmaier, revealing chilling details about murders in Washington, Utah, Colorado, and Idaho.


06:45 – 12 PM

With 19 hours left until the execution of Ted Bundy at Florida State Prison, lunch is served — but he barely eats. Outside, the crowd cheers, holding signs. Bundy’s Once seen as the “All American Boy,” Ted Bundy now faces the truth. The image is gone. Only the serial killer remains.

07:55 – 1 PM

Ted Bundy’s final goodbye.
At Florida State Prison, he receives one last emotional visit from his mother, Louise Bundy. She once believed in his innocence — but with the Ted Bundy execution near, even hope fades. Alone in his cell, Ted Bundy reflects on the past and prepares for his final TV interview. The final day of Ted Bundy continues to unfold.

09:25 – 3 PM

Ted Bundy gives his final interview.
Just hours before the Ted Bundy execution at Florida State Prison, he sits down with Dr. James Dobson, a Christian psychologist. Under tight guard, Bundy confesses to his crimes, speaking about childhood, pornography addiction, and dark urges. He blames violent media and personal demons — but claims full responsibility. This becomes the chilling Ted Bundy interview.

10:23 – 3 PM to 12 AM

The final hours of Ted Bundy’s life unfold.
After the chilling Ted Bundy interview with Dr. James Dobson, he returns to his Florida State Prison cell. The weight of his confessions grows heavier. Detectives rush to verify his final clues.Outside, the crowd waits. Inside, Ted Bundy shares disturbing details about victims like Donna Manson and Georgeanna Hawkins. Detective Keppel listens, knowing Bundy is still hiding more. In these final hours, surrounded by silence and memories, the serial killer reflects, breaks down, and reveals secrets — but it may be too late.

13:11 – 12 AM

The countdown begins at Florida State Prison.
As the Ted Bundy execution nears, crowds gather near Florida State University, where he once attacked students. Laughter and smoke fill the night air. Signs read “Watch Ted Fry.” But for others, it’s a heavy moment.

13:37 – 1 AM to 6 AM

Ted Bundy’s final night at Florida State Prison.
Alone in his cell, he made emotional calls to his mother, searching for comfort. He tried reaching Carole Ann Boone, but she never answered. His lawyer, Polly Nelson, visited one last time — holding his head and crying goodbye. Ted Bundy’s last meal untouched. The Ted Bundy execution was just one hour away.


14:50 – 6 AM

Ted Bundy’s final walk to the electric chair.
At 6:00 AM, inside Florida State Prison, Bundy took a quiet shower and put on clean clothes. Reverend Fred Lawrence arrived for prayer and communion. By 6:30 AM, guards led him to the chamber. Behind the glass, victims’ families and reporters waited. Outside, the crowd cheered, holding signs like “Burn Bundy Burn.” The electric chair was ready — wires, straps, and the switch. No more lies. No more delays. Just silence… and the end.

16:57 – 7 AM

At Florida State Prison, Ted Bundy was strapped into Old Sparky. 2,000 volts surged through him. At 7:16 AM, Ted Bundy was declared dead. The Ted Bundy death made headlines. Some cheered, others mourned. Justice was done — but pain remained.
